source.x-scope: Independent fresh-checkout review of implementation commit c7bd8d4 against base 5e6de1be. CE-reviewed set equals the 85-file pinned diff; the 71 handoff-scope CLI subjects are a subset (extras: generated bundle + metafile/sha256, release-records-docs-a7 quick baton, specs/002 artifacts). Vendor bytes verified by lock verify rather than prose review. No fixes applied: the coordinator forbids implementation during review, so safe_auto items are reported open. Full suite not rerun by instruction; targeted checks only (lock verify, feature handoff validate, archive-adopt reproduction).

findings.title: Template adoption leaks source feature 002 and adopter validate fails with six E_MISSING_ARTIFACT errors
findings.x-resolution: T030: exact source002 retirement in cleanup and four template smoke assertions; adoption regression verifies removal, byte-preserved independent adopter feature and successful adopter validation.
findings.reason: No task covers template disposition of the new source feature; converge must append a dedicated task (cleanup remove entry plus adoption coverage).
findings.x-evidence: Reproduced independently from git archive HEAD c7bd8d4 in an isolated temp repo: BATON_FORCE_CLEANUP=1 adopt --no-workflows exits 0, specs/002-context-optimization-packs survives, validate --json exits 1 with E_MISSING_ARTIFACT for src/lib/context-guards.mjs, src/commands/context.mjs, test/integration/context.test.mjs, packs/token-budget.yml, packs/optimize.yml and docs/06-packs-and-customization.md. The remove list retires specs/001-baton-template/ but not specs/002-context-optimization-packs/. Smoke workflows assert only 001 absence (smoke.yml:42,76,117; mvp-windows-smoke.yml:39). adopt.test.mjs derivedCopy copies the working tree; feature 002 read_first gained removed/moved source paths only at the implement receipt, so earlier coverage could pass while leaking the feature. Violates docs/solutions/quick-lane-scope-and-stranded-land-2026-09-29.md lesson (a).
findings.x-fix: Add specs/002-context-optimization-packs/ to the remove list; extend adoption coverage (and smoke assertions where appropriate) to prove source 002 is removed while a separate adopter-owned feature survives. Do not weaken validation or blanket-delete adopter specs; no production adopt logic change expected.

findings.title: Restore reads and deletes the .full.md backup without checking it against protected/excluded paths
findings.x-resolution: T031: both actions protect backups before reads/mutations. Six exact-code modes cover cross-baton read_first/hash, managed, excluded existing/absent and case-aliased backups; invalid excluded bytes are not decoded.
findings.reason: Executable guard violates FR-007/FR-009 and the cross-baton protection edge case: a hash-bound or read_first backup is consumed and removed.
findings.x-evidence: L233 checks only the target against protection.protectedPaths. backupPath (L252-253) is never checked; restore reads it (L264) and rm(backup) at L290. Adversarial reproduction: another feature's handoff binding specs/002-draft/spec.full.md with its sha256; restore preview allowed:true, apply exit 0, backup deleted, then context scope for that feature fails 'Required context source is missing'. Security reviewer independently raised the same gap.
findings.x-fix: Refuse compact and restore (preview reason and apply) when key(backupPath) is in protectedPaths or excludedPaths; add an integration case where another baton binds the backup.

findings.title: Restore without backup: preview reports allowed and apply leaks raw ENOENT as E_INTERNAL exit 10
findings.x-resolution: T032: preview reports missing backup with allowed:false; apply returns E_CONTEXT_PROTECTED and the relative backup path, with unchanged snapshots.
findings.reason: contracts/context.md requires an existing backup and repository-standard diagnostics naming target/reason.
findings.x-evidence: Preview returns at L246 before any backup check; restore branch calls readFile(backup) unguarded, so ENOENT reaches cli.mjs:68-74 as E_INTERNAL with an absolute path. Compact branch uses optionalBytes and a typed E_CONFLICT. Correctness and adversarial agree; adversarial reproduced exit 10.
findings.x-fix: Check optionalBytes(root, backupPath) for restore before building the report; add a preview reason and throw a typed BatonError with the relative backup path on apply; add a regression test.

findings.title: Same-feature baton without optional decisions crashes compact/restore preview with TypeError
findings.x-resolution: T032: optional decisions type/default matches the schema; schema-validated omitted-decisions fixture previews successfully. Multiple same-feature handoffs are separately refused as ambiguous.
findings.reason: decisions is not in handoff.schema.json required; elsewhere code uses data.decisions ?? [].
findings.x-fix: Use (data.decisions ?? []).some(...); add a fixture baton without decisions.

findings.title: Restore trusts any sibling .full.md without compaction provenance and replaces the current target unrecoverably
findings.x-resolution: T036 implements the minimum non-contract-changing remedy proposed by review: backup_sha256 and explicit restore-overwrite/provenance warning; docs explain loss of later edits and unauthenticated sibling backups. No new persistent provenance protocol.
findings.reason: Downgraded from P1: apply requires --expect bound to the current target digest, so replacement is explicit; still, a backup not produced by compaction is accepted and post-compaction edits are discarded without a recovery copy.
findings.x-evidence: Adversarial scenarios: unrelated user spec.full.md restored over a never-compacted spec (exit 0, original gone); FR-999 edit after compaction lost on restore with preview digest.
findings.x-fix: Record backup/compacted digests at compaction and verify on restore, or preserve the current target with wx before rename; at minimum surface the backup digest in the preview.

findings.title: Protection matrix accepts E_CONTEXT_PROTECTED or E_CONFLICT for every mode and protected restore asserts only nonzero exit
findings.x-resolution: T033: exact E_CONTEXT_PROTECTED per protection branch and restore; only stale digest accepts E_CONFLICT. Schema assertions prevent malformed approval fixtures from passing for the wrong reason.
findings.reason: A protection regression masked by the stale-digest conflict, or a restore failing for an unrelated reason, keeps AC-US2-2 green.
findings.x-fix: Assert one exact code per mode (E_CONTEXT_PROTECTED for read_first/hash/approved/history/malformed/managed; E_CONFLICT for stale) and errors[0].code for restore refusals (L114-116).

findings.title: Contract refusals lack tests: protected backup, missing backup, missing --expect/--candidate, candidate aliases, whitespace candidate, duplicate --target, absent token-budget pack, ambiguous handoffs
findings.x-resolution: T031-T033: executable backup, missing-input, target/backup/backslash alias, whitespace, duplicate target, absent token-budget, excluded candidate and ambiguous-handoff cases assert exact diagnostics and unchanged snapshots.
findings.reason: Guard branches at context-guards.mjs L248-264/L304 are unexercised; F02/F03/F04 escaped because of these gaps.
findings.x-fix: Extend the exact-code refusal matrix with these modes and unchanged-snapshot assertions.

findings.title: No Windows path-form, case-variant, drive-absolute or ADS target tests
findings.x-resolution: T033: exact-code unit cases cover uppercase, drive absolute, rooted slash/backslash and ADS forms; canonical backslash paths remain supported. Integration cases exercise case-folded exclusions and backslash candidate aliases.
findings.reason: Spec edge case requires Windows case aliases not to evade protection; unit test uses a loose catch-all regex.
findings.x-fix: Add backslash, uppercase, C:/, leading-slash and ':stream' cases with exact codes.

findings.title: Compact preview reports allowed while apply will refuse an existing backup or invalid candidate
findings.x-resolution: T032: preview checks existing/missing backups and supplied candidate content/aliases, reports allowed:false and reasons, and remains non-mutating.
findings.reason: Preview-then-apply flow in wrappers can mislead agents; either add deterministic precondition reasons or document that allowed covers protection only.

findings.title: Approval-signal branches (non-draft phase/status, attach-approved, schema-invalid handoff, malformed manifest/lock JSON) untested
findings.x-resolution: T033: phase, status, attach-approved, schema-invalid handoff and malformed manifest/lock cases added. Every generated approval fixture is schema-validated before use.
findings.reason: Regression in these guard branches would make approved artifacts compactable without a failing test.

findings.title: Optimize apply/flag/absent-pack and output-slimming tests assert only nonzero exit or one of three codes
findings.x-resolution: T033: optimize apply/flags assert E_USAGE, absent-pack refusal names optimize, readable output uses valid candidate/expect with exact E_CONTEXT_PROTECTED/exit1. Positive reports assert protected files, totals and byte-identical snapshots.
findings.reason: L172-183 and L235-243 accept any failure; assert exact E_USAGE / pack-missing codes and E_CONTEXT_PROTECTED with valid candidate/expect.

findings.title: scope/usage enumerate only top-level feature files, omitting contracts/**/*.md targets
findings.x-resolution: T034: bounded contracts-tree discovery includes nested Markdown, skips links/backups and honors case-normalized file/tree exclusions before reads. Scope and usage assert exact files and estimates.
findings.reason: Usage under-reports context size relative to contextTarget's allowed set.

findings.title: Protected-marker regex duplicated three times in mutateContext
findings.x-resolution: T031: one non-global PROTECTED_MARKER constant covers targets, candidates and backups.
findings.reason: Security-relevant guard copies at L234/L261/L265 can drift; hoist to one constant/helper.

findings.title: Token estimate formula and label duplicated across context modules
findings.x-resolution: T034: shared estimatedTokens and TOKEN_ESTIMATE define formula/label for mutation previews and advisory reports; tests retain independent numerical expectations.
findings.reason: Math.ceil(length/4) and the estimate label repeat at context.mjs:63/65/85/89 and context-guards.mjs:245/292.

findings.title: Optional-source pin field list repeated in sync, lock verify and lock projection
findings.x-resolution: T035: frozen OPTIONAL_PIN_FIELDS drives verification/projection; tests assert exact contents, immutability and unchanged lock field order.
findings.reason: sync.mjs:400, lock.mjs:54 and sync.mjs:301 must change together; export one field list.

findings.title: fetchAtv keeps an inline MIT check instead of the new verifyMitLicense helper
findings.x-resolution: T035: ATV reuses verifyMitLicense with its existing copyright/message; source-specific copyright verification remains enforced and tested.
findings.reason: Two implementations of the same license policy in one module.

findings.title: Bundle limit written as expression and separate 460800 literal
findings.x-resolution: T035: BUNDLE_LIMIT_BYTES supplies comparison/error text; strict 450 KiB boundary and independently spelled-out test budget are unchanged.
findings.reason: Use one BUNDLE_LIMIT constant for the comparison and message; D6 value unchanged.

findings.title: context.mjs depends on the guard-internal lowercase/slash key format for exclusions
findings.x-resolution: T034: advisory and guard code share contextExcluded, which owns canonical keys and directory-prefix exclusion semantics.
findings.reason: Expose isExcluded(protection, path) or export key() and use it at L61/L83.

findings.title: Bundle-cap increase listed under Added instead of Changed
findings.x-resolution: T036: approved cap increase is under Unreleased / Changed; no release or tag.
findings.reason: Keep a Changelog 1.1.0 files changes to existing enforced limits under Changed.

findings.title: Optional lock tamper cases assert only generic E_LOCK_MISMATCH
findings.x-resolution: T037: optional pin/row mismatches identify their source and exact field; 17 tamper cases plus raw-line-ending tampering assert precise diagnostics and E_LOCK_MISMATCH.
findings.reason: Assert the tampered field/source appears in the diagnostic so per-field checks cannot silently regress.

findings.title: Eligibility check ignores quick batons and treats features without a handoff as eligible drafts
findings.reason: Approved design: plan.md:108 allows a missing first handoff when other checks establish an unbound draft (manifest, lock and all-baton read_first/artifact protection still apply). Spec edge case for quick-lane batons concerns batons that refer to the target, which protectedPaths enforces across all feature and quick batons. The quick-baton approval scenario was not reproduced.
